content.what_it_is: A headerless 400-row, three-column numeric gauge dataset for the sph_sol_plane_ana benchmark. The first column increases from about 0.105 to 125.075, while the second and third columns contain signed small-magnitude series; the third column includes several NaN gaps.
entities: Third-column NaN gaps interspersed with finite values (lines 217-264)
unresolved: The file has no header or companion definition in the supplied content, so the three column meanings and units are not defined (lines 1-400).
The third column contains NaN intervals, including the run beginning at line 217, without an in-file missing-data explanation (lines 217-264).
